description: Post a message to a CarlNotes team's chat as a member, optionally as a reply to one of its messages. A message that names Carl gets his reply in the chat. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to post in the team chat, tell my team, or reply in the team chat.

reply_to_chat_message_id.description: A message id from read_team to reply to.

team_id.description: The team's id, from list_teams or read_team.

name: post_to_team_room
title: Post in a team chat
